infrastructure — 基础设施
That means people who do not drive can still travel easily." Repairing the bridge would also mean less disruption to the existing road infrastructure, because no new roads would need to be built.

trade-off — 权衡；取舍
This is a difficult trade-off between cost, time, and the environment.

downstream — 下游地
Option B is to build a new bridge 500 metres downstream.

pedestrians — 行人
The new bridge would have four lanes, a separate bus lane, and a wide path for bicycles and pedestrians.

oppose — 反对
Some residents support the repair because it is cheaper and faster, while others oppose it because of traffic problems in the town centre.

rejected — 拒绝；否决

temporary — 临时的
The council also considered a third idea: a temporary ferry service during the repair work.

arguments — 论点；理由
A repaired bridge is cheaper now, but a new bridge may serve the town better in 30 years." The decision is not easy, and both sides have strong arguments.
